name: Dungeon Burai
source:
One day a huge hole that appears in the house. It is a secret entrance of a secret organization "Jyuuichi Kuchuuru" that aims for world domination. The house owner accused them of land fraud and organized a party to throw them out of there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一天，房子里出现了一个大洞。这是以统治世界为目标的秘密组织“十三空”的秘密入口。房主指控他们诈骗土地，并组织了一场聚会将他们赶出了那里。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
